prompt: Across all released seasons, how many episodes of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power were not directed solely by Charlotte Brändström?
answer: 16 episodes. The series has 24 episodes across three seasons, and Charlotte Brändström directed 10 episodes. Of her credits, two Season 1 episodes and three Season 2 episodes were directed solely by her; the remaining 16 episodes were not directed solely by her.
